data.comment:
# Comfy Image Outpainting- Bria

Expand an image beyond its original borders using Bria's outpainting API, generating new surrounding content that matches the original lighting, perspective, and texture while leaving the source untouched. Choose from preset aspect ratios, custom dimensions, or manual canvas placement, with optional text prompts to guide the expansion direction or an auto-generated prompt when left blank. Ideal for extending compositions for print layouts, creating panoramic versions of existing photos, and adapting artwork to new formats or social media dimensions. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bria_expand_image.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: The night city street continuing seamlessly beyond the original frame, matching the existing scene: blurred colorful city lights in blue, orange and yellow, wet asphalt road with reflections of the neon lights, modern building silhouettes in the background, the same motion-blurred aesthetic and cool blue-grey color grading, empty street with no other cars, realistic night photography style
